title: Sleep Needs in Children
subtitle: Evidence, common problems, practical routines, and safety related to sleep needs in children.
evidence_strength: Established evidence for age-specific sleep needs and safety guidelines; moderate evidence for impact of screen time and behavioral interventions; emerging evidence on individualized sleep variability and nap roles; ongoing research into long-term consequences of pediatric sleep deprivation.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
